description:
Inputs for a remote command execution over SSH.

The compute target (host/user/key) comes from a ``compute.ssh`` connection via
``ctx.compute`` (bind ``execution.compute_target``), never from here.

command.description: Shell command to run on the remote host (the workflow author's; run from a script file, not interpolated).
command.title: Command

workdir.description: Remote working dir; default a fresh ~/.cairn-jobs/<id>.
workdir.title: Workdir

upload.description: Local file paths to SFTP into the workdir before running.
upload.title: Upload

fetch.description: Remote paths/globs (relative to workdir) to SFTP back on success.
fetch.title: Fetch

env.description: Env vars exported before the command.
env.title: Env

title: RemoteExecInput
